caption: The drawing depicts a three-seater sofa with a high, scalloped backrest composed of three vertically divided sections. The upholstery appears dark brown with a subtle texture. The armrests are rolled and curve outward from the main body of the sofa. The seat cushion matches the backrest in color and texture, spanning the width of the sofa. The frame at the bottom is a lighter brown wood, visible below the seat and supporting the structure. The sofa stands on four legs; the front legs are ornately carved, featuring a scroll motif and decorative detailing, while the rear legs are simpler, straight, and set at an angle. The overall background is an off-white or cream color, with no additional objects or decorative elements present.
title: Sofa
